"""Runs 6-7 (sdh-spot-check, D = 0): raw traces, onset, 1/B FFT vs F_L and the model tones."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
from fs_count_b0 import abab_fs
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

H_4E = 4.1357e-15 / 4  # h/4e in T per m^-2

spots = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}  # run id -> n (1e12 cm^-2), both at D = 0 (run-5 cal)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 7.5))

for i, (rid, n12) in enumerate(spots.items()):
    r = run(rid)
    B, x = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col("sr1_X")
    amp = r.meta["instruments"]["sr1"]["snapshot"]["parameters"]["amplitude"]["value"]
    i_bias = amp / r.meta["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"]
    R = x / i_bias  # sr1 unity gain
    order = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[order], R[order]
    F_L = abs(n12) * 1e16 * H_4E
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / i_bias)
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {F_L:.1f} T, I_bias = {i_bias*1e9:.1f} nA ===")
    print(on.summary()); print()

    ax = axes[i, 0]
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    ax.axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"onset {on.onset_b:.2f} T")
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ω)", title=f"run {rid} raw — n = {n12:+.1f}e12")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)

    ax = axes[i, 1]
    m = B > 0.3
    dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax.plot(B[m], dR, lw=0.6)
    ax.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="ΔRxx (Ω)", title="MR background removed (deg-5 in B)")

    ax = axes[i, 2]
    for cut in (on.onset_b, on.onset_b * 1.2, on.onset_b * 1.5):
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()))
        ax.plot(freqs, spec[0], lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T")
    ax.axvline(F_L, color="k", ls=":", lw=1.2, label=f"F_L = {F_L:.1f} T")
    _, orb = abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)
    for F, _kf in orb:
        if F > 0.5:
            ax.axvline(F, color="tab:green", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    ax.set(xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT amp", xlim=(0, F_L * 1.6),
           title="FFT in 1/B (green dashes: model ABAB pair)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)

fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# model context at the spot densities (scale = geometry prior)
for n12 in (+3.2, -1.2):
    _, orb = abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)
    F_L = abs(n12) * 1e16 * H_4E
    print(f"model @ n={n12:+.1f}e12: F_L={F_L:.1f} T; ABAB pair "
          + ", ".join(f"{F:.1f} T [{F/F_L:.2f}·F_L]" for F, _ in orb)
          + f"; ABCA singleton {F_L:.1f} T")

**Read (runs 6–7).** Both sides show clean SdH; **electron side is the fan side** — lower onset (censored at the 0.30 T record edge vs 0.71 T hole-side), higher reachable density (hole side gate-capped at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹², inside the near-CNP exception regime where the model's ABAB pair collapses to 5.9/6.5 T — unseparable templates).

**Run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** dominant tone **7.1 T** — on the model's ABAB light pocket (7.3 T) — with a k×7.1 comb (14.1/22.1/29.5) plus low tones {3.0, 4.2, 5.1, 9.5}, all censored at the record edge. The pivotal ambiguity: **22.1 T** is either 3×7.1 (harmonic) or the ABAB heavy pocket (model 25.8 T) at a global scale ≈ 0.88 (then 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 = 0.88·F_L closes the Luttinger sum inside the lever-arm prior); likewise 29.5 is either 4×7.1 or a singleton at 0.89·F_L (ABCA-domain candidate). One density cannot break these — the n-trajectories can: a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n) exactly, a real pocket follows its own Onsager curve. **Run 7 (n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** bunched tones 6.6 (strong), 4.7, 8.5, 9.4, 12.3 — consistent-with a close, balanced near-CNP pair (12.3 ≈ 2×6.2 beat/harmonic ambiguity); expected exception regime, not classification-grade. **Next: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0** — design inherits onset lower-bound 0.3 T, Δ(1/B) ≈ 0.01 T⁻¹ (Nyquist 50 T > 1.5·F_L(3.2e12)), sensitivity/settling per the spot checks.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side at D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:30** · landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n +1.00..+3.20e12 (56 cols, 0.04 step), B 0.3->10 T uniform-1/B (325 rows, d(1/B)=0.00998/T), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), leak trip 1 nA; ends 10 T · **ETA ~17:30** (≈12h)

Spot checks read (ana runs 6–7): the electron side carries the fan — onset ≤ 0.3 T (censored at the run-6 record edge), strong tones, and density reach to +3.2×10¹² (the hole side is gate-capped at 1.27×10¹², inside the model's near-CNP exception regime). Run 6's pivotal ambiguity — 22.1 T = 3×7.1 harmonic **or** ABAB heavy pocket (model 25.8 T at global scale ≈ 0.88, closing the Luttinger sum); 29.5 T = 4×7.1 **or** an ABCA-domain singleton at 0.89·F_L — is exactly what per-column FFT trajectories break: a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n), a real pocket follows its own Onsager curve (`tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Steps 4–5).

**Design (computed, `landau-fan` step 1):**
- **B_lo = 0.3 T** — run-6 `sdh_onset` = 0.30 T, censored ⇒ valid lower bound. No low-field extension: the claim's resolution is already met at 0.3 T (δF = 1/(1/0.3 − 1/10) = 0.31 T; tightest needed split 7.1 vs 9.5 T = 2.4 ≫ 2δF), and the harmonic-vs-pocket discrimination comes from n-trajectories, not single-column δF — record below 0.3 T would cost +50% rows for nothing the claim needs.
- **Δ(1/B) = 0.00998 T⁻¹** (325 rows, uniform-1/B, ascending 0.3 → 10 T from the parked magnet) — ⅓-Nyquist on F_L(n_max) = 33.1 T → covers to 50 T: fundamentals at scale prior 1.2 and the observed 29.5 T comb member. B_max = 10 T buys the high-B window for the F_L-tone origin B-split check and ν = 8, 12, 16 ladder reach at low n (the ≥ 8 T rows cost only ~20 min in this grid).
- **n = +1.0 → +3.2×10¹², 56 columns** (step 0.04×10¹²) — n_max at the gate ceiling where templates separate; light-partner 5-period window floors at n ≳ 1.6×10¹² (model f_partner(1.6) ≈ 2.3 T; span 3.23 T⁻¹ ⇒ 7 periods), so the partition-trajectory claim spans 1.6–3.2 and the low columns track the heavy-tone → F_L merge. Ray-Nyquist on the raw image holds at B ≥ 0.83 T; the per-column FFT is column-independent below that.
- **Sensitivity 100 µV** (10 kΩ FS at 10 nA): worst corner low-n × high-B anchored by run 7's measured 576 Ω at 10 T → ~17× headroom for ν ≈ 4 QH peaks; high-n floor 0.7% FS readable per run 5. **fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ** (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — per-column-FFT settling class), slow_delay 1 s.
- **Price** (session-calibrated: run 5 → 0.17 s/pt overhead over fast_delay): 18 200 pts × ~2.0 s = 10.0 h + 9.7 T blocking traverse 1.2 h + row turnarounds 0.4 h ≈ **11.6 h → call it 12 h**. Measurement-dominated regime per the VTI variant; each lever at its floor — this is the one fan.

**Checkpoints:** first rows (~15 min: rail/leak/signal level, T); periodic digest reads every ~1–2 h (leakage, rails, rate, T); interim per-column FFT once B > ~2 T (~85% through, the low-B rows are the bulk of wall-clock); full read on completion. Leak guard 1 nA → interrupt. Ends at 10 T, gates at n = +3.2×10¹² (metallic, the LK-mass candidate point).

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.0 -> +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.3 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- fast axis: paired n-line at D = 0 (run-5 calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(1.0, 3.2, 56)          # 1e12 cm^-2; step 0.04e12 -> raw-image ray read floored at B >= 0.83 T
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtgs.min() and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert BG_MIN <= Vbgs.min() and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: {len(ns)} pts, n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12, D = 0; "
      f"Vtg [{Vtgs.min():+.4f}, {Vtgs.max():+.4f}] V, Vbg [{Vbgs.min():+.4f}, {Vbgs.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B; B_lo = 0.3 T (run-6 measured onset, censored -> lower bound); d(1/B) = 0.00998 /T
#     -> FFT Nyquist 50 T = 1.5x F_L(n_max = 3.2e12) (covers scale prior 1.2 and the observed 4x7.1 = 29.5 T comb)
B_vec = field_invB(0.3, 10.0, 325)      # ascending: magnet sits at 0; ends at 10 T for a ride-down follow-up
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff state0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner is low-n x high-B:
# anchor run 7 (|n| = 1.2e12, 10 T) measured 576 Ohm max -> ~17x headroom for the nu ~ 4 QH peaks at n = 1.0e12.
# High-n floor: R ~ 70 Ohm = 0.7% FS, readable (gatemap run 5 read 0.6% FS fine). Lose resolution, never saturate.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]:.2f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.1f} T uniform-1/B; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; fast_delay 1.8 s = 6*tau (per-column-FFT class)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: n = +1.00 to +3.20e12 (56 pts), D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B 0.3 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (325 rows, d(1/B) = 0.00998/T), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} to {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (56 pts, 0.04e12 step); '
              f'B = 0.3 -> 10 T uniform-1/B, 325 rows, d(1/B) = 0.00998/T (Nyquist 50 T vs F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'inherits sdh-spot-check runs 6/7 (onset <= 0.3 T censored, tones 7.1 + k-comb, 9.5, 22.1 vs F_L)')
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0]); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg_curr, k_bg_curr, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=1, fast_delay=1.8)
# End state, deliberate: field stays at 10 T (follow-up rides down as a measured traverse — never re-traverse);
# gates stay at the n-line end (n = +3.2e12, D = 0 — metallic; the LK-mass candidate spot).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
